claims.statement: Tom Allen believed prize fighting should be held in the open air, not in enclosed arenas, and that boxing would survive the closing of the New Orleans clubs.

claims.statement: Tom Allen signed his letter of December 1894 as 'Retired Champion of the World'.
claims.excerpt: THOMAS ALLEN, Retired Champion of the World.

quotes.speaker: Tom Allen
quotes.text: To my mind Bowen was clearly whipped then.

quotes.speaker: Tom Allen
quotes.text: Fighting flourished before the New Orleans’ clubs were ever heard of, and it will continue to do so after they have gene out of existence.

notes: Letter to the editor signed Thomas Allen. Allen's comments on Bowen are opinion, not a bout of his own.
